data.name: Irfan
data.gender_notes: Irfan is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic ʿirfān, 'knowledge, gnosis', from the root ع-ر-ف (ʿ-r-f). Its root is ع-ر-ف (ʿ-r-f). A common Muslim given name. Irfan is a Arabic name meaning “Knowledge; learning; gnosis”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Irfan expresses “Knowledge; learning; gnosis”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic ʿirfān, 'knowledge, gnosis', from the root ع-ر-ف (ʿ-r-f).
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Irfan total 30, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.
